questions.title: Data Structure Complexity
questions.description: Which data structure provides O(1) average case lookup time?
questions.explanation: Both dictionaries and sets use hash tables for O(1) average lookup time.

questions.title: List Operations
questions.description: Complete the code for common list operations:
questions.text_with_blanks: To add an item to the end of a list, use _____. To remove and return the last item, use _____. To find the index of an item, use _____.
questions.explanation: append() adds to end, pop() removes from end, index() finds position.
